scope: Existing repository evidence only; no provider runs performed for this report

application_fixture.limitations: Fixture path; excludes browsers, models, payment processing, and human review.

hosted_external_caller.scope: One sandbox-paid read-only research call; merchant completion untested

fresh_parallel_rehearsal.limitation: One fresh overlapping rehearsal. This measures browser-wait compression for the same observations, not sustained throughput, human-active time saved, checkout readiness, or purchases. Amazon ran separately in 12188ms.

hosted_four_lane_rehearsal.limitation: Actual four-lane routing and bounded failure containment; Fiverr and food did not complete in this hosted mission.

component_form_preparation.note: The source's reported step count and listed tool-call count disagree; both are preserved.
component_form_preparation.environment: Local synthetic HTML form plus actual Claude API; not merchant form

free_registration.confirmation_email_scope: One pinned query, one metadata read and one eligible body read; Inbox true, spam/trash false, zero external actions.
free_registration.timing_caveat: The 17330ms cycle includes preparation, review retrieval and missing-passkey rejection checks. Approval-to-confirmation includes manager delay before Register now. Neither measures isolated adapter latency or human-active time; do not sum these separate scopes.
free_registration.prepare_review_guard_elapsed_scope: Total verification cycle: POST prepare-registration, GET registration-review, and missing-passkey approval rejection (HTTP403). Not isolated proposal preparation, browser-adapter, or execution latency.

concurrency_and_integrity.note: Synthetic fixture data in actual Supabase. Two budget-conflicting approvals test atomic reservation/overspend prevention, not a global one-approval limit or capacity.

merchant_preflight.source: bounded session observation immediately preceding this report; no provider rerun for impact analysis

amazon.required_human_step: Sign in privately, add exact quantity one, and review the checkout total before ordering.

fiverr.required_human_step: Sign in privately, select the exact package, and review total and fees before ordering or contacting the seller.

food_selected_state_latest.limitations: Tax, final total, pickup time and availability remain unverified; no cart, checkout, payment or order.

hosted_voice_draft_historical.limitation: Editable draft only; no real user microphone, mission submission, approval, or merchant action.

hosted_voice_draft.limitation: Editable draft only; no real user microphone, mission submission, approval, or merchant action.
hosted_voice_draft.elapsed_scope: Hosted browser voice round trip including upload/server/provider/response/UI handling; not isolated Gemini latency. Synthetic4.842s recording duration is separate.

derived.caveat: Numeric lanes-per-hour extrapolations were removed because one run does not establish sustained throughput, a benchmark distribution, scale or capacity. Lane attempts and options are not completed purchases.
derived.confirmed_event_throughput_note: One confirmation is functional evidence only. The 27.428 s interval includes manager delay and is not a throughput benchmark.

reference_only.warning: The first value linearly extrapolates one observed caller cost; the second uses a sandbox fee and is not revenue evidence. Unknown costs are excluded.

illustrative_projections.signed_difference_note: Preserve negative differences as added labor. Report failure/handoff rates beside matched-success savings. Monthly projection is not measured scale.

supported: One workspace with scoped caller and manager identities
Atomic budget reservation and overspend rejection
not_supported: Multiple manager roles or approval quorums

required_measurement_inputs: At least 10 matched manual-versus-Cue trials per task class
Identical independently checked quality endpoint for both arms; time-to-blocker is not time-to-success; record unsuccessful trials and all their elapsed/active time
Separate human active-time and wall-time stopwatches
Strict success labels for grounded option, checkout-ready, and confirmed commitment
Provider and model invoices or metered unit rates
Production Stripe processing fees, failures, and refunds
Login-ready merchant accounts and exact checkout totals
Production completion rate and handoff resolution rate
Multi-user tests only after team RBAC exists
